newsitem.title: USA: Margate sees plant impact in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Margate sees plant impact in Q4.

text.p: Margate Industries Inc said Monday it expects to see some continued impact in the fourth quarter from the start-up of a new Wisconsin facility and the consolidation of two Michigan plants.

"We are addressing these challenges and, though we expect to see some continued impact from them in the fourth quarter, we believe the Michigan and Wisconsin operations can contribute long-term shareholder value through sales growth and profitability," William Hopton, president, said in a statement.

Earlier, Margate, which through two subsidiaries provides specialized cleaning, grinding and chipping of iron castings, reported a third quarter net loss of $0.11 a share, compared with a year-ago loss of $0.05.
Results were affected by the Wisconsin start-up and the Michigan consolidation, the company said.

"We are making progress at both facilities," Hopton said. "The Michigan operation has already returned to operating profitability, and we are working to correct the situation in Wisconsin in order to make the most of strong customer interest."
